Iran-Gulf States Meeting on Strait of Hormuz Postponed

A planned meeting between Iran and Persian Gulf foreign ministers to discuss reopening the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed. Iranian officials stated the meeting was stalled, dealing a blow to diplomatic efforts. The postponement occurred as broader Middle East diplomacy faces delays. Specific reasons for the stall in talks were not detailed in the coverage.
